source: World Bank Open Data API (api.worldbank.org/v2)，各國取最新一年有數值的資料

SI.POV.DDAY.name: Poverty headcount ratio at $3.00 a day (2021 PPP) (% of population)
SI.POV.DDAY.note: Poverty headcount ratio at $3.00 a day is the percentage of the population living on less than $3.00 a day at 2021 purchasing power adjusted prices. As a result of revisions in PPP exchange rates, poverty rates for individual countries cannot be compared with poverty rates reported in earlier editions.

SI.POV.LMIC.name: Poverty headcount ratio at $4.20 a day (2021 PPP) (% of population)
SI.POV.LMIC.note: Poverty headcount ratio at $4.20 a day is the percentage of the population living on less than $4.20 a day at 2021 international prices.

SI.POV.UMIC.name: Poverty headcount ratio at $8.30 a day (2021 PPP) (% of population)
SI.POV.UMIC.note: Poverty headcount ratio at $8.30 a day is the percentage of the population living on less than $8.30 a day at 2021 international prices.

SI.POV.GINI.name: Gini index
SI.POV.GINI.note: Gini index measures the extent to which the distribution of income (or, in some cases, consumption expenditure) among individuals or households within an economy deviates from a perfectly equal distribution. SI.DST.10TH.10.name: Income share held by highest 10%
SI.DST.10TH.10.note: Percentage share of income or consumption is the share that accrues to subgroups of population indicated by deciles or quintiles.

SL.TLF.CACT.FM.ZS.name: Ratio of female to male labor force participation rate (%) (modeled ILO estimate)
SL.TLF.CACT.FM.ZS.note: Labor force participation rate is the proportion of the population ages 15 and older that is economically active: all people who supply labor for the production of goods and services during a specified period.

HD.HCI.LAYS.name: Learning-Adjusted Years of School
HD.HCI.LAYS.note: Learning-adjusted years of school are calculated by multiplying the estimates of expected years of school by the ratio of most recent harmonized test scores to 625.

SE.TER.ENRR.name: School enrollment, tertiary (% gross)
SE.TER.ENRR.note: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown. Tertiary education, whether or not to an advanced research qualification, normally requires, as a minimum condition of admission, the successful completion of education at the secondary level.

SL.EMP.VULN.ZS.name: Vulnerable employment, total (% of total employment) (modeled ILO estimate)
SL.EMP.VULN.ZS.note: Vulnerable employment is contributing family workers and own-account workers as a percentage of total employment.

SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS.name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS.note: Unemployment refers to the share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.

FS.AST.PRVT.GD.ZS.name: Domestic credit to private sector (% of GDP)
FS.AST.PRVT.GD.ZS.note: Domestic credit to private sector refers to financial resources provided to the private sector by financial corporations, such as through loans, purchases of nonequity securities, and trade credits and other accounts receivable, that establish a claim for repayment. For some countries these claims include credit to public enterprises. The financial corporations include monetary authorities and dep

FR.INR.LNDP.name: Interest rate spread (lending rate minus deposit rate, %)
FR.INR.LNDP.note: Interest rate spread is the interest rate charged by banks on loans to private sector customers minus the interest rate paid by commercial or similar banks for demand, time, or savings deposits. The terms and conditions attached to these rates differ by country, however, limiting their comparability.

NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD.name: GDP per capita, PPP (current international $)
NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD.note: This indicator provides values for gross domestic product (GDP) per person expressed in current international dollars, converted by purchasing power parities (PPPs).
